mapper.sql: id, request_id, request_version, gripper_id, task_type, task_status, container_main_id, from_location_id, to_location_id, target_height_mm, layer_count, dispatched_time, completed_time, cancelled_time, cancelled_reason, operator, remark, created_time, updated_time
mapper.select: SELECT gt.id, gt.gripper_id, gt.task_type, gt.task_status, gt.container_unit_id, gt.created_time, gt.completed_time, cm.alias_code, cm.container_type FROM gripper_task gt LEFT JOIN container_main cm ON gt.container_unit_id = cm.id WHERE gt.gripper_id = #{gripperId} ORDER BY gt.created_time DESC

SELECT
FROM gripper_task WHERE gripper_id = #{gripperId} AND task_status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RETRY', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED') AND done_time IS NULL ORDER BY CASE task_status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 WHEN 'DISPATCHED' THEN 1 WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 2 WHEN 'RETRY' THEN 3 WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 4 WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END, priority_level DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM gripper_task WHERE gripper_id = #{gripperId} AND container_main_id = #{containerMainId} AND task_type = 'PICK' ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT 1
